title: Cloud Storage
subtitle: Manage cloud storage providers for file uploads. Enable providers, designate one as default, configure console URLs, custom expiry, and logos.

card.customExpTimeHint: Allow requests with a custom signed-URL expiry time (e.g. large PDFs, videos)
card.noLogo: No logo — click Upload to add one

enable.title: Enable {{provider}}?
enable.body: {{provider}} will become available for file uploads.

disable.title: Disable {{provider}}?
disable.body: This provider will no longer be available for uploads. If it is currently the default, another enabled provider will be selected automatically.

setDefault.title: Set {{provider}} as default?
setDefault.body: {{previous}} will no longer be the default. All new uploads will be routed through {{provider}}.

deleteLogo.title: Delete {{provider}} logo?
deleteLogo.body: The logo file will be permanently removed from storage.

replaceLogo.title: Replace {{provider}} logo?
replaceLogo.body: The existing logo will be overwritten with the selected file.
